Read a table set

Source: R/table_set.R
seq_read_table_set.Rd

Reads a versioned set of related tables, either from a directory or from an in-memory list of data frames. A directory holds <prefix>.<table>.tsv files, a <prefix>.columns.tsv manifest (columns table, column, type) and a <prefix>.schema_version file whose first line is <set>, a tab and an integer version. Column types are character, integer, numeric or logical. Character cells are percent-decoded (%09, %0A, %0D, %4E, then %25) and NA is read as a missing value.

Usage

seq_read_table_set(x, set, supported = 1L, required = NULL, prefix = set)

Arguments

x

A directory path, or a list of data frames carrying a schema_version element or attribute. Data tables are accepted.

set

Name of the table set, checked against the version file.

supported

Integer schema versions that are accepted. Any other version is rejected.

required

Named list mapping table names to required column names.

prefix

File prefix of the set in a directory.

Value

A named list of data frames with attribute schema_version.
